question: What liberating power is attributed to Pāṇḍunātha in this salutation?
premises: He is called the cause of liberation.
The salutation is repeated for emphasis.
inference: Pāṇḍunātha is honored as the one who brings about liberation.
plain_english: O Pāṇḍunātha, salutation to you; salutation to you, O cause of liberation.
